intro: Serbia's economy mixes farming, car-making and a growing IT industry.

chapters.title: Raspberries and plums
text: Serbia is one of the world's largest producers of raspberries, and its plums are turned into šljivovica, a plum brandy on UNESCO's heritage list.

chapters.title: Factories and tech
text: Car factories, Chinese-owned steel and copper plants and a booming IT sector are important. Plans for a large lithium mine have sparked protests over the environment.

keyTerms.meaning: A metal used in rechargeable batteries.
